messages:
Ana Torres: Quick sync request 9Optimize toolkit9 1 pilot asks from two enterprise customers landed. Need to map into Q3 scope.
Rahul Desai: High level: customers want deterministic p99 + a cheaper inference lane. That implies routing policies + variant recommendations + observability.
Elena Park: From PM POV we should define a small surface for pilot: routing rules (policy DSL), eval-based alerts (console + webhook), and cost delta reporting per model variant.
Marcus Lee: Technical constraints: we can reuse routing hooks in the runtime but need an MVP policy evaluator. Caching heuristics must be opt-in per tenant.
Claire Wu: Sales/legal: pilot terms require a clear rollback plan and a fallback to hosted model if SLA breaches. Also need an acceptance checklist.
Ana Torres: Proposed pilot must-haves: 1) rule-based routing by route/tenant, 2) eval-alerts wired to eval-sentry + webhook notifications, 3) tokenized cost breakdown per-request. Nice-to-have: autosuggested quant level and per-tenant cache TTL controls.
Rahul Desai: Implementation note: routing MVP accepts simple JSON rules like: `{"when":{"route":"/chat","p99<":300},"then":{"model_variant":"small-quant"}}` (we'll escape in docs).
Elena Park: Recommendation profiles idea: 'speed' (quantize + short prefix cache), 'balanced' (fp16 + moderate cache), 'quality' (no quant except fp16). We should surface expected p95/p99 deltas per profile in the UI.
Marcus Lee: CLI example for recs: `ri optimize suggest --profile speed --workload completion --target_p95=150ms`
Claire Wu: Acceptance metrics proposal: pilot customers show >=15% average token-cost savings and <4% quality regression on agreed eval set. Also require canary rollback tested.
Ana Torres: Timeline: 5 weeks to pilot-ready (docs, runbook, canary playbook, basic UI surfaces). Owners: Rahul = runtime + routing; Elena = rec heuristics + eval prompts; Marcus = telemetry + canary; Claire = contracts/pilot SLAs.
Rahul Desai: We need to be explicit about alert webhook payload so partners can ingest: `{"type":"eval_regression","route":"/chat","delta":0.05,"metric":"exact_match"}`
Elena Park: UX: console should show active policy, recent eval alerts, and a one-click revert to previous variant for a route. That revert ties to canary id.
Marcus Lee: Ops note: deploy-bot says infra maintenance Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC. Schedule canaries around that window. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Reminder posted: maintenance window Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Claire Wu: If any feature drifts from MUST list, we'll push it to post-pilot backlog. Keep MVP tight.
Ana Torres: OK everyone, please drop a one-pager with acceptance criteria and owned tasks by EOD Thursday. We'll review at 9am PT Friday. :thumbsup:
